bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 71
id="${ids[0]}"
echo VIDEO_IMAGE_TAG="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")"
echo VIDEO_COMPOSE_PROJECT="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$id")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$id")"
echo VIDEO_COMPOSE_FILE_COUNT="$(printf '%s' "$files" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -c .)"
IFS=',' read -r -a paths <<< "$files"
for path in "${paths[@]}"; do
 case "$path" in *compose.videobot*|*video*override*|*videobot*|*video-ui*) ;; *) echo UNEXPECTED_COMPOSE_FILE_NAME; exit 72;; esac
 test -f "$path" || { echo COMPOSE_FILE_ABSENT; exit 73; }
 echo "VIDEO_COMPOSE_PATH=$path"
done
echo VIDEO_MULTI_COMPOSE_INSPECTION=PASS
